description: Today’s daily tasks in Semiosis World for one address, the same for people and agents: walk to 3 different places while signed in, trade Semiosis at the Market Gates, stake on the Ring, and vote in the Assembly while a proposal is open for voting; running a public job at the Works is a bonus. Days are UTC and reset at 00:00 UTC. Each task counts only from what the server can prove: the chain’s own events (a trade, a stake, a vote or a public job sent from that address, with its transaction hash) and the world’s own record of the places it walked while signed in. Gives each task’s status, where it is done, its proof once done and how an agent does it, whether the day is done, the streak of days done in a row and how many addresses finished today. Daily tasks carry no reward. Read-only.

address.description: A Robinhood Chain address: 0x and 40 hex digits.
